Name: The Farmer's Children (LittleNPC)
Author: xiddav
Description:
[center][color=#e06666][b]﻿[size=3]DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS and[/size][size=4] [url=https://github.com/AshleyNGames/TheFarmersChildren]github[/url]﻿ [/size][/b][/color]
[color=#e06666][size=3]Do Not Upload this mod to another site.[/size][/color]
[/center]
[center][color=#f9cb9c][b][size=5]Your two children are now big kids that get to go to school with Jas and Vincent.
They will travel around Pelican Town exploring their interests outside the farmhouse. [/size][/b][/color][/center]

[center]﻿﻿[/center]
[left][size=2]﻿Your 1st born loves animals and fish. They like to spend time with Jas and Vincent after school, but has a habit of falling asleep in class. 
Child 2 prefers a quite places so they can read, though some days a trip to the saloon's arcade is fun. They ask a lot of questions, and can be a bit rude to others.[/size]﻿

[size=6]
[b]There are [i]2[/i] downloads for this mod[/b][/size]
[size=3][b]The Farmer's Children[/b], which contains Dialogue, Schedule, Gift Tastes, ect.
[b]The Farmer's Children Art [/b], this comes in three versions. [u]Simplified, Standard, and Deluxe. [/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/885]Setting up your children[/url] 
Do not have more then one ART mod installed.

If you want to use [b]other [/b]art, note that this mod contains sprite animations that toddler sheets [b][i][u]do not[/u][/i] [/b]have, and 7 portrait emotions.[/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][size=3]Neutral[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Happy[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Sad[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Questioning[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Sleepy[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Angry[/size][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Magic![/size][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][b]The Farmer's Children Art[/b] does not change toddlers. Only LittleNPCs.


[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/1300]First Born's Schedule
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2599]Second Born's Schedule
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/351]Base Gift Tastes (more changes based on Spouse are not listed)[/url][/size]





[size=6][b]Thing to note about other mods:[/b][/size]
[quote]﻿[size=3][b]LittleNPC [/b]
required

turn child wander off in [u]config.json
[/u]kids get lost at the busstop with it on

Multiplayer
﻿I have no way to test if it works in multiplayer or not. Try at your own risk.

I recommend not lowering the "AgeWhenKidsAreModified" config to be less the 56. Default is 83.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=3][b]Farmhouse[/b] (any farmhouse mod)

Modded farmhouses [b][u]might [/u][/b]change NPC warps, causing the children to not leave the house or walk into the void. This is an issue with the farmhouse mods if it is happening.

The Farmer's Children does not change anything that happens inside the farmhouse. If something weird is happening in the house, I most likely can't do anything about it.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540]Unique Children Talk[/url]﻿[/b] 
compatible

The issue with invisible toddlers talking has been fixed by UCT

Unique Children Talk does not effect the LittleNPCs. 
The Farmer's Children does not effect toddlers, including the unique talking ones.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=3][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18972]Immersive Family[/url]﻿[/b] 
compatible

It is recommended to increase the "AgeWhenKidsAreModified" config in LittleNPC so that all Immersive Family events happen first. That is 2 years plus the age difference between the 1st and 2nd child.

If the kids become LittleNPCs, the events will still happen, but the immersion is lost since it is the babies and toddlers in the events, not the current LittleNPC versions. Or you can pretend that it is a flashback to before they became LittleNPCs.[/size][/quote]
[quote][size=3][b]Multiple Spouse mods
[/b]
The Farmer's Children uses the token {{spouse}}, so whoever the spouse mod you have handles that token is which parent the kids take after. It might not be the one who asked to have kids.[/size][/quote][/left]
[b][color=#ffff00][size=6]Special thanks[/size][/color][/b][size=6]  [/size]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#444444][spoiler][/color][color=#ff7700]Eros[/color][color=#3d85c6]DkAl[/color] (Fixed my terrible art when the mod was new)[/font]
not only fixing the girl portrait I created (it was a badly edited Jas), but also for making her seasonal and making them look like their parents, and making the sprites seasonal to. ♥
Also fixed the boy portraits to look a bit less like Vincent.
you rule Eros ♥





[b][size=4]If you make a translation, feel free to upload it to Nexus yourself.


No need to ask permission to restyle the kids. Just let me know so I can check out your work ♥[/size][/b]
